title: Orthogonal JEPA: Factorized Predictive States for Latent World Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.20065v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: World models construct latent states that support prediction, planning, and reasoning about an underlying system. Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) offer a direct way to learn such states by predicting targets in representation space instead of reconstructing every detail of the observation. Standard JEPAs, however, organize all predictable content through one target embedding and one prediction pathway. In complex systems, this monolithic state can allocate redundant capacity to dominant signals while providing weak or conflicting gradients to less dominant predictive structure. We introduce \method, a latent world-modeling framework based on orthogonal predictive factorization. Learned basis matrices analyze each target state into multiple components, and a dedicated prediction branch estimates each component from a shared context representation. translated_title: 正交JEPA：用于潜在世界模型的因子化预测状态
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20065v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：世界模型构建潜在状态，以支持对底层系统的预测、规划和推理。联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）提供了一种直接学习此类状态的方法，通过在表示空间中预测目标，而非重建观测的每个细节。然而，标准JEPAs将所有可预测内容组织到一个目标嵌入和一条预测路径中。在复杂系统中，这种单一状态可能将冗余容量分配给主导信号，而对次要预测结构提供较弱或冲突的梯度。我们引入了\method，一种基于正交预测因子化的潜在世界建模框架。学习到的基矩阵将每个目标状态分解为多个组件，并且一个专用的预测分支从共享的上下文表示中估计每个组件。预测回归保留了状态合成所需的因子幅度。
tldr: 本文提出了一种正交预测因子化框架，通过将目标状态分解为多个独立组件并分别预测，克服了标准JEPA在复杂系统中因单一状态导致的容量分配不均和梯度冲突问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an orthogonal predictive factorization framework that decomposes target states into multiple independent components for separate prediction, overcoming capacity misallocation and gradient conflicts in standard JEPAs within complex systems.
